title: A recurrence in logarithmic Möbius sums with coprimality conditions via Euler--Maclaurin
summary: We derive a recurrence for logarithmically weighted Möbius sums by combining Möbius inversion with the Euler--Maclaurin summation formula. Consequently, starting from estimates of orders zero, one and two, we obtain polynomial approximations for these sums for every nonnegative integer exponent of $\log$. We then extend these estimates to sums with coprimality conditions via a convolution identity and to sums weighted by the reciprocal of the sum-of-divisors function.
